name: academic-pipeline
description: v0.6.0: Stage 5 now plans the end matter and Stage 6 writes it, closing a gap where the required sections were declared in stage four and produced by no stage at all. Stage 6 numbers Vancouver citations by first appearance while drafting. Stage 7 dedupes on normalized DOI or URL rather than on BibTeX key. A new Stage 9 release gate runs five named checks and blocks the completion report when any fails. v0.5.0: Reader-facing deliverables are named from the run's target slug rather than a constant, so a paper lands in the vault under its own title. The formatting skill no longer carries a worked example with a person's name in it, after a fabricated surname was found in the author block. End-to-end academic content pipeline: BibTeX theme mapping, perspective and voice capture, Academia.edu formatting, structure planning, iterative drafting, bibliography generation, and a 10-phase professor critique. Voice-first — authentic voice and journal formatting are fixed before drafting, never retrofitted.
